reason: The negative estimate comes from controlling for mgmt_rating_2023, a 2023 post-treatment variable (a collider or mediator) that training and productivity both affect. When I re-ran the model with only pre-period controls, the training coefficient was positive (about +0.58, SE 0.23), and adding mgmt_rating_2023 flipped it to about -2.3. The 'negative effect' conclusion is an artifact of that control.
